title: Fire in the Water
about: A track about contradiction, duality, and balancing opposing sides of identity.
description: Fire in the Water explores the internal contrast between logic and emotion, control and chaos, introversion and expression. It shows how opposing traits can coexist without canceling each other out. Instead of choosing one side, the track embraces both, presenting contradiction as balance rather than conflict.
lyrics: Verse 1

I see patterns, but I break them when they don’t fit
Structured soul with a chaos I won’t omit
Quiet in a room, then I flip when it’s right

I’m both sides, never stuck in a lane
Cold calculations with a heart full of flame

I don’t follow lines, I redraw the shape
Half in control, half ready to break
Chorus
I’m fire in the water, I don’t choose a side
Burnin’ while I’m driftin’, got both in my mind
I’m calm, I’m chaos, I question what’s true
Half built on logic, half feelin’ it through
I don’t fit the frame, I move how I move
Too deep for simple, got nothin’ to prove
Verse 2

Chorus
I’m fire in the water, I don’t choose a side
Burnin’ while I’m driftin’, got both in my mind
I’m calm, I’m chaos, I question what’s true
Half built on logic, half feelin’ it through
I don’t fit the frame, I move how I move
